//: Points the editor's type checker at the project's virtualenv.
Without this, basedpyright/pyright resolves imports against whichever
interpreter the editor happened to pick, and reports every third-party
package as unresolved — openai, django, rest_framework, celery. They are
all installed; the checker was just looking somewhere else. The effect is
worse than the noise suggests: a few hundred false 'could not be resolved'
hints teach you to ignore that entire category, which is the category a
genuinely missing dependency shows up in.
django-stubs is not installed, so Django's dynamic attributes (objects,
reverse accessors, model fields) cannot be resolved statically. Those
specific rules are off rather than left to produce noise on every model.
ruff remains the authority in CI.
